verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline order and the tagline on the lighter sky, but the translucent band has broken into stray rectangles (one empty box at mid-left, another at the bottom), the two chevron sets are merged into one row sitting on the busy city, and 'London' is pushed off-axis to the right of the kicker. B flips the reading order ('London' sits above 'FAMILY DAYS OUT IN'), leaves an empty band fragment at the top, and puts the tagline over the busy cityscape where it can barely be read; the chevrons are jammed against the bottom edge on top of the image.
